title: Eval prompt lineage and adjudication workflow for gated rollouts
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Introduce a lightweight, auditable eval prompt lineage and adjudication workflow that ties prompt-set provenance to canary/A-B/shadow rollouts. The goal is to make gating decisions explainable and to enable rapid human adjudication for ambiguous regressions so we can reduce false positives and avoid unnecessary rollbacks. This ticket covers: (1) prompt-set metadata capture and versioning, (2) automated drift/scoring per prompt with provenance to model and dataset versions, (3) an adjudication UI task flow for reviewers to mark prompts as flaky/invalid/blocked, and (4) integration hooks so rollout controller uses adjudicated verdicts when computing gate pass/fail.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt-set ingestion pipeline captures source, author, checksum, and ingest_timestamp for each prompt version and persists snapshot metadata
Eval runner emits per-prompt scores with model_version, seed, and deterministic trace_id into the scorecard store
A minimal adjudication UI/exposure via Console allows reviewers to mark prompts and append notes; verdicts are stored and versioned
Rollout controller consults scorecard + adjudication verdicts and can be configured to ignore prompts flagged as flaky or excluded for a customer cohort
End-to-end test demonstrating a staged canary flip where one failing prompt is adjudicated as 'flaky' and gate transitions to PASS without rollback
technical_notes: Store prompt lineage in existing eval-metadata service as immutable snapshots (use S3 + metadata DB row with checksum) rather than altering runtime prompt content
Extend scorecard schema to include: prompt_id, snapshot_id, model_version, deterministic_seed, token_length, raw_output_blob_ref, metric_vector
Adjudication verdicts are small enums: OK | FLAKY | INVALID | BLOCK; include reviewer email and timestamp for audit
Rollout controller should compute two aggregated signals: raw_score_aggregate and adjudicated_score_aggregate. Use adjudicated aggregate for gating if configured
To limit cost, sampling policy: only evaluate full golden set on canary if divergence on lightweight probes > threshold; otherwise incremental eval
Consider eventual integration with eval-weighting service for cohort-specific prompt prioritization
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Backend schema + snapshot ingestion (backend-only, feature flag off)
Phase 1: Scorecard emission and retention + basic console adjudication view (internal only)
Phase 2: Tie adjudication verdicts into rollout controller with a feature flag and simulated dry-run for 48h
Phase 3: Enable for selected customers and run with shadow traffic for 2 weeks
Phase 4: Gradual rollout to all canaries, enable automatic use of adjudicated aggregate for gating
monitoring: Track prompt-level evals processed per minute and alert if pipeline falls below expected throughput
Alert if adjudication queue stalls (>24h pending reviews for high-priority prompts)
Monitor false-positive rollback rate before and after adoption (target: 40% reduction)
Create dashboard showing distribution of verdicts by prompt source, author, and time
Expose per-release divergence heatmap using adjudicated vs raw aggregates
rollback_criteria: If adjudicated_score_aggregate drops below threshold and more than 5 prompts are BLOCK in last 10k evals, auto-rollback
If adjudication rate of FLAKY grows >20% in 72h, pause automatic gate usage and open a review incident
Manual rollback allowed by SRE/PM via console with audit entry required
test_plan: Unit tests for metadata snapshot persistence and checksum validation
Simulated eval harness that injects controlled failures and verifies adjudication changes gating outcome
E2E smoke that creates a prompt snapshot, runs evals, marks prompt FLAKY in UI, and verifies rollout controller ignores it
Load test for scorecard ingestion at expected peak traffic: 50k evals/min
